issues.description: The template and problem statement expect an assembleBookstore() function with no parameters, but the solution defines assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore while main() calls assembleBookstore() without arguments. This parameter mismatch (solution adds a 'count' parameter but is invoked with none) is a structural inconsistency that will cause confusion and a compile error if code is run as shown.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the unused 'count' parameter in the solution (change to private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) or update main() to call assembleBookstore(count: <Int>) and adjust the problem statement/template to document the parameter. The simplest fix is to remove the parameter so assembleBookstore() matches the template and problem description.
